title: Service Desk Guide to Paying for Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards
content:
No card type in the Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards program carries a fee for buying the card: the purchase fee is 0.00 USD on every type. What differs by type is the tender the card can be bought or loaded with, the most worth of that type one customer may buy in one day, and whether a bulk order can be charged to a Northgate Business invoice account.

## Purchase terms by card type

| Card type | Fee charged when buying the card (USD) | Tenders accepted to buy or load the card | Most worth one customer may buy per day (USD) | Bulk order can be charged to a Northgate Business invoice account |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Gift Card | 0.00 | cash, debit card, Northgate Card | 2000.00 | no |
| Northgate eGift Card | 0.00 | debit card, Northgate Card, external credit card | 1000.00 | no |
| Northgate Merchandise Return Card | 0.00 | not applicable, the card is not sold | 0.00 | no |
| Northgate Promotional Gift Card | 0.00 | not applicable, the card is not sold | 0.00 | no |
| Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card | 0.00 | ACH, check, Northgate Business Card | 50000.00 | yes |
| Northgate Reloadable Gift Card | 0.00 | cash, debit card | 1000.00 | no |

## Points the table settles

- **Tender lists are complete for each type.** A Northgate eGift Card can be paid for with an external credit card; a Northgate Gift Card and a Northgate Reloadable Gift Card cannot, because that tender is not in their lists.
- **Loads use the same list.** The accepted tenders cover loading value as well as buying the card, so a reload of a Northgate Reloadable Gift Card is paid with cash or a debit card.
- **Cards that are never sold.** The Northgate Merchandise Return Card and the Northgate Promotional Gift Card have no accepted tender and a daily purchase figure of 0.00, since neither type is bought.
- **Invoice charging** is available only on Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card orders.

## Illustrations (hypothetical purchases)

| Hypothetical purchase | Result under the table |
|---|---|
| A Northgate Gift Card of 40.00 paid in cash | tender accepted; no purchase fee, so the customer pays 40.00 |
| A Northgate eGift Card of 25.00 paid with an external credit card | tender accepted; the customer pays 25.00 |
| A Northgate Reloadable Gift Card paid with a Northgate Card | tender not accepted for this type |
